title.narrative: Empowering Cultural Practitioners in Malawi for Enhance Artistic Freedom of Expression

description.narrative: Artists in Malawi face censorship and legal constraints and have limited platform for artistic expression. These problems impede the ability of practitioners to engage meaningfully with the community and influence change. Thus, the project seeks to overcome these obstacles by providing the necessary training, resources and support to empower artists. It seeks to create a thriving culture sector in Malawi where freedom of expression is respected, upheld and celebrated. The impact of the project is an enabling and thriving culture sector that contributes towards greater freedom of expression, democracy and socio-economic development in Malawi. The project is designed to enhance the capacity of cultural practitioners in Malawi to freely express themselves, advocate for their rights and contribute to a vibrant and inclusive cultural sector.
